text:
nia: spotted a transient cross-org leak in console when toggling Quick Switch rapidly. saw quota numbers from prior org for a second. repro on prod at 11:03 UTC.

omar: steps?

nia: 1) login org-X 2) open Quick Switch peek 3) switch to org-Y then back to org-X within ~500ms 4) quota card shows org-Y numbers briefly

ravi: any network traces?

nia: yes: GET /internal/quota?card=summary 200
Response body meta.org: "org-Y" but request header x-org-id: org-X.

omar: that implies the edge or client cache returned a stale body not keyed by org header. we recently added URL-normalization to drop query order noise; maybe we inadvertently dropped header inclusion.

ravi: quick look: internal-proxy cache key is currently computed as `path + sorted(query)` for speed. not including auth headers. bug.

nia: client-side also has an in-memory cache keyed by URL only. code snippet: `if (cache[url]) return cache[url]`.

omar: mitigation plan: 1) update proxy to include x-org-id in cache key for /internal/* endpoints 2) change client cache key to `${url}|${orgId}` 3) emit telemetry `console.cache.org_mismatch` when response.meta.org != ctx.org (sample 1%)

ravi: I'll open PR for proxy config and client change. add e2e that does rapid switch under parallel users.

cache-bot: cache purge initiated for /internal/quota keys at 1779998895.

nia: severity P1 for cross-tenant read exposure. prioritizing patch.

omar: rolling canary after PR passes. also add an alert if telemetry > 10/min.

ravi: PR #8520 opened, tests + telemetry added. staging passed.

nia: thanks. assigning ravi to rollout, omar to ops alert. closing unless repro shows up. :thumbsup:
